newsitem.title: USA: Lucent creates voice/video over Web venture.
newsitem.headline: Lucent creates voice/video over Web venture.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Tuesday it had set up a new "business venture group" to sell software to give businesses and consumers high-quality voice, music and video over intranets and the Internet.

The company said products from the venture, known as the elemedia (elements for multimedia) venture group, will include voice software, which enables "telephone quality" conversations over the Internet.
By next quarter, the former AT&T equipment unit said its elemedia venture will provide software that enables home and business-quality videoconferencing over the Internet.

"We're capitalizing on a more than a decade of Bell Laboratories software research and development in packet technologies to bring Internet telephony to the level of quality people are accustomed to," said elemedia President Joe Mele.

Packet technologies refers to the standard method of sending data over networks by breaking it into small packages of electronic bits on the sender's end of a transmission and reassembling the packages on the receiving end.
However, the packet-transmission method has severe limitations when used to send real-time voice or video images.
Packet-transmission is the basis of Internet communications.
Voice or video communications typically have a jerky, degraded quality when transmitted via the packet delivery method.

Lucent said its technology would resolve such drawbacks, allowing for high-quality voice or image transmission over the Internet that could compete with conventional methods of telephone and broadcast video transmission.
"This software will help move voice, music and video over the Internet beyond the current base of technologists and hobbyists and into the mainstream," Mele said.

The package of products, to be sold under the Media Plus family name, will include software components that are designed so software vendors, Internet service providers and other companies can integrate them easily into products and services they provide to customers.
The elemedia group is the second business venture created by Lucent Technologies to market Bell Labs software innovations.
The first was the Inferno business venture, announced in May, which markets the company's new distributed network operating system software.
